name: claude-layout
description: Lays out three Claude Code terminals in the active window: Bohuslav | Radomír on top, Vendelín at the bottom. Trigger with `claudes` in the integrated terminal.

claudeLayout.auto.description: Also open the three Claude terminals automatically whenever a folder is opened (otherwise only on `claudes` / the command).

claudeLayout.sessions.description: Terminals to open. Columns 1 and 2 are the top row, 3 is the bottom row. Empty model = Claude default. icon = any codicon name, color = a terminal.ansi* theme color.

claudeLayout.delayMs.description: Pause between starting the terminals, in milliseconds.

claudeLayout.boot.description: Play the boot sequence in each terminal before Claude starts.
